lead: A new `.nvs` or `.nvst` anywhere under `tests/` joins `nvs-syntax`'s `lossless` corpus, which only fails at the end of the session.
body: `lossless` demands every byte be covered by a token or a trivium, which the `<?nvs` a shebang file refuses was not. Expect a case exercising a recovery path to be what finds a hole in `rule:ide/tokens-plus-trivia-reproduce-the-file`.
